New, much larger, much more time-sinkey track!

[ATTACH]1226528[/ATTACH]
Welcome to Mudstone Valley, so far it looks like this might be the first map like this in the Repo/Forums/Mod Manager

This is a little tighter track than you'd find in a desert, rocks, logs, whoops, mud, water...  Long ultra 4 course with a qualifier!
[LEFT][ATTACH]1226526[/ATTACH]
[ATTACH]1226524[/ATTACH][/LEFT]
There arent too many very technical sections, but there are a few big hills!
[LEFT][ATTACH]1226523[/ATTACH]
[ATTACH]1226527[/ATTACH]
[ATTACH]1226525[/ATTACH][/LEFT]
Dont know if anyone actually reads these things, but bring your big boy tires and lockers and have it at it, again I'll mention a big thanks to DennisW for making some awesome cars to drive on this!

When I get more time, I eventually want to start adding other tracks in some of the dead space, maybe a couple new short course/UTV tracks in the dead zones in the middle.
modData.tag_line: A long, east-coast style ultra 4 race track/map, hope you're not afraid of trees!
